from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected = "61ffe358c866c419b4af7f369f6446eed3f072f7"
head = subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"], cwd=wt, text=True).strip()
status = subprocess.check_output(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"], cwd=wt, text=True).strip()
if head != expected or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected worktree state head={head} status={status!r}")

for rel in ["src/do_again/core/executor.py","tests/test_executor.py","README.md"]:
    p = wt/rel
    print(f"=== {rel} ===")
    lines = p.read_text().splitlines()
    for n,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        if any(k in line for k in ["operation", "status", "scratch_script", "read_file", "git_status", "allow"]):
            start=max(1,n-5); end=min(len(lines),n+16)

            for i in range(start,end+1):
                print(f"{i:04d}: {lines[i-1]}")
